evaluation.interpretation: Contextual internal validation, not independent external performance or safety claims.

threshold_selection.provenance: Selected configuration, training-only out-of-fold P(Potability=1); no test labels used.
threshold_selection.rule: Keep .5 if OOF FPR <= .02; otherwise maximize safe recall at threshold >= .5 under that cap; stricter threshold wins ties; >1 means no safe predictions.
threshold_selection.caveat: Empirical constraint, not a safety guarantee. Wilson interval is descriptive; model/threshold selection adds uncertainty.
